The default model is now **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash**. It reads documents as accurately as Qwen 3.8 27B at about a quarter of the time per page.

## Changes

- **New default model: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash** (`@cf/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`), sent with `reasoning_effort: none`. On the test documents it matches Qwen 3.8 27B: typed letter word F1 0.998 (Qwen 0.997), form with handwriting 25/26 (26/26), degraded copy with handwriting 18–19/21 (18–19/21). Pages take a median of about 4 s instead of 16 s, at about $1 instead of $3.50 per 1,000 pages. Confidence scoring still works, because DeepSeek returns log-probabilities.
- **Reasoning is off for the default model.** With DeepSeek's default reasoning, dense pages used up the output limit before any text was written. `PAPERLESS_CF_OCR_EXTRA_PARAMS` still overrides this.
- **Repetition loops are retried.** Models sometimes get stuck repeating one line, such as `[illegible]`, until they reach the output limit. Such a truncated answer used to be kept as the page text. Now it is retried, for any model. If it keeps happening, the page falls back to the second-opinion model or Tesseract, like any other failed page.

## Upgrading

- **The default model now needs the Workers Paid plan.** On the free plan, set `PAPERLESS_CF_OCR_MODEL=@cf/qwen/qwen3.8-27b` to keep the previous behaviour.
- If you already set `PAPERLESS_CF_OCR_MODEL`, nothing changes for you except the retry of repetition loops.
- Docker: `ghcr.io/nnmalex/paperless-cf-ocr:0.2.0` (or `:0.2`). Native: `sudo -Hu paperless pip3 install --no-deps paperless-cf-ocr==0.2.0`.

## Compatibility

Unchanged: Paperless-ngx 3.0.5 to 3.5.1, and Python 3.11–3.14. End-to-end tests passed in the official Docker image for every 3.x minor release, and against a live Cloudflare gateway with the new default model.
